environment.description: Same Ktor service on ECS Fargate behind ALB. WebACL attached with AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesUnixRuleSet (version 1.1) in BLOCK mode with sensitivity level HIGH, plus a custom rule group 'symlink-traversal-block' with regex pattern set matching body parameters containing path traversal sequences (../|..%2f|..%252f|/etc/|/proc/|%2fetc%2f) applied to FieldToMatch: Body with TextTransformation URL_DECODE priority 1 and DOUBLE_DECODE priority 2. Additionally, the EFS access point is configured with POSIX UID/GID 1000:1000 and root directory creation permissions 0755 with path /app-data, and the container runs as non-root UID 1000 with a read-only root filesystem and tmpfs on /tmp only. The EFS mount uses the 'nosymfollow' mount option via the ECS task definition mountPoints configuration.

config.filesystem: EFS access point with enforced POSIX UID 1000:1000, root directory /app-data, mount option 'nosymfollow'
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
